name: route
title: Route
description: Model-routed branch — the signature *bounded non-determinism* primitive. Run `selector` (typically a `!model` op) to produce a label, then run the `case` whose `label` it names. The cases are fixed and analyzer-validated: the model chooses *which* declared branch runs, never *what*. Falls back to `default` when the label matches no case (an error if `default` is empty).
